_comment: Automation buildings. power: positive = consumes, negative = produces. link: network link range in metres.

machines.name: Automatic Dust Collector
machines.desc: Cleans the ground around it, then extracts deep regolith forever.

machines.name: Conveyor Segment
machines.desc: Links machines up to 16 m apart into one network.

machines.name: Charging Station
machines.desc: Powers drones and rovers within 45 m. Also recharges your suit.

machines.name: Cleaning Drone Bay
machines.desc: Launches a cleaning drone that scrubs up to 35 m away.

machines.name: Autonomous Rover Garage
machines.desc: A self-driving rover mows dust within 60 m.

machines.name: Processing Station
machines.desc: Refines raw dust into polished moon powder worth 3x.

machines.name: Automated Shipping Depot
machines.desc: Rockets your network's dust to Earth buyers every 30 s.
